messages:
From: Asha Mehta <asha@brightbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Guest slot in Brightbridge Executive Briefing series

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — I run partner programming at Brightbridge Consulting. We’re putting together a short executive briefing series (30–40 minutes, followed by 10–15 Q&A) for senior product and platform leaders focused on productionizing LLMs. We’d love Redwood to be a guest to speak about inference economics and hybrid deployment patterns.

High-level ideas we can feature:
- Cost/latency tradeoffs with dedicated vs hosted inference
- A short customer case highlight (5–7 minutes)
- Practical checklist for moving from POC to production

Dates we have available: May 12, May 19, or June 2 (all EDT). We’re aiming for joint promotion (email, blog swap, and a shared landing page). Brightbridge will handle registration and moderation.

If this sounds good I can send a short partnership memo and speaker agreement. Would you be able to join live for Q&A? If not, we can do a pre-recorded 15-minute demo + live panel.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing if we can make this happen.

Best,
Asha Mehta
Director, Partnerships | Brightbridge Consulting
attachments: Brightbridge-series-onepager.pdf (pdf)

Hi Asha — great to meet you over email and thanks for the invite. Redwood would be very interested; this topic lines up perfectly with a couple of customer stories we’ve been preparing.

Quick answers:
- We can do May 19 (preferred) or May 12 as a backup.
- Format: 25 minute talk (exec + 10 minute demo) + 15 minute live Q&A works well.
- Promotion: happy to do the blog swap and a joint landing page — Ben can own creative + copy.

Next steps I propose:
1) We sign a short speaker agreement (DocuSign link OK).
2) I’ll loop in Karthik (tech lead) and Ben (demand) to own demo and promotion respectively.
3) We’ll share a 1-pager and speaker bios by May 5.

I attached a one-pager with suggested talking points and a proposed demo checklist.

Marissa
VP, Alliances | Redwood Inference
